summary: Strong Phase 2 artifact with an exemplary audio graph, genuinely audible effects, and exceptional real-boundary evidence, held back mainly by an incomplete piano library. Direct browser inspection (headless Chromium against the sealed production build at localhost:4823, AnalyserNode tapped on the real master gain, plus AudioContext-construction counting injected before load) confirmed: one AudioContext; layer buses through the documented Mod1->Mod2->Delay->Amp/EQ->Comp->Reverb order into master gain -> limiter -> one destination; Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets that load offline, sound (RMS 0.0015-0.0039 under --mute-audio tab) and are spectrally distinct; two layers with correct per-layer voice ownership, level fader binding (0..127, audible mute), and octave shift doubling the fundamental (258->527 Hz); KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre (node gains follow state: treble -4.5 dB Soft, threshold -21 dB at Dyn Comp 1, readable only while the graph processes - a Chromium getter quirk I ruled out), Unison, Soft Release, String Res and Master Level all change canonical state and rendered/live audio; every effect family processes real audio (tremolo modulation 2.4x dry, delay repeats with LP-filtered repeat tail, LP24 centroid collapse, compressor dynamic range 16.2->1.8, Booth vs Cathedral tails, rotary fast 5.0x stop modulation via To Rotary); focus/group/global targeting, per-unit and all-FX bypass, wet/dry, tap tempo (~520 ms for 500 ms taps) all verified against store state and sound; MIDI-denied, asset-failure fallback (labeled synthesized, playable, never 'ready'), blur/pointercancel cleanup, 24-voice stealing and panic all behave; zero console errors across every session. The candidate's 203 tests pass (23 files) and include real OfflineAudioContext renders (node-web-audio-api) with measured assertions and graph-connectivity traversal. Key gaps: Clav/Digital/Misc types have no model at all (spec requires all six types playable, honest synthesis permitted - selecting them reports 'Piano not found' and plays nothing); SUSTPED/PSTICK exist only as indicator LEDs, not toggles; no on-screen UI sustain control (Space/CC64 only); several spec-excluded features (half-pedaling, pedal noise, delay feedback-loop effects, Analog mode) were implemented functionally instead of staying decorative (honestly declared); typecheck depends on @types/node being resolvable from a parent directory. Visual surface and narrow retention against Phase 1 captures show no drift.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
evidence: Compared canonical evidence/stage2-desktop.png and stage2-narrow.png with stage1-desktop.png/stage1-narrow.png and with my own live 1440x900 and 390x844 screenshots of the running build: continuous red chassis, 73-key E-E keybed, six sections, 54/46 deck/keybed split, materials and typography are unchanged; no clipping or lost controls at 390x844.

Only documented deliberate deltas observed (Delay FILTER button added per real hardware; previously-static LEDs now stateful), matching evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md; stage2-capture.json records empty consoleMessages/pageErrors for both canonical captures.
Live DOM probe: [data-testid=deck-block] height 54%, keys-block 46%, all sections present; no marketing content or reference photo rendered.

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
evidence: Zoomed live screenshots of the deck with state engaged (layer B on, Delay/Reverb on): layer letters and FX FOCUS LEDs, unit ON LEDs, active type-token highlighting (e.g. HALL in the Reverb variation row), timbre BRIGHT/MID/SOFT LEDs, rotary SLOW/FAST LEDs, layer-level LED graphs and Program OLED all reflect canonical state.

DOM state probe: piano-layer-a aria-pressed=true, piano-layer-b false, reverb-on false after bypass, piano-on true, perf-master-level aria-valuenow=100, oled-piano-line '▤ A: Salamander Grand', oled-edit-line shows truthful last edit ('Delay Tempo 521 ms'); functional controls data-decorative=false, Organ controls data-decorative=true.
Program display piano line updates on every selection including 'Piano not found (Clav)'; PANIC shows 'PANIC — all notes off' on the edit line.

criteria.label: Distinct Piano instruments
evidence: Grand/Upright/Electric are real bundled recorded sets served from dist/samples (90/19/19 mp3 files on disk, loaded same-origin, offline-capable): live analyser shows all three sound (max RMS 0.0015/0.0015/0.0039 in a muted headless tab) with distinct spectral centroids (77.2/84.3/61.3); rendered-audio tests (render-library.test.ts) additionally assert pairwise distinctness. Provenance (roots, velocity layers, license CC BY 3.0 / MIT) is complete and truthful in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json and src/audio/library.ts; Salamander Grand has 30 roots x 3 recorded velocity layers with crossfading.

GAP: Clav, Digital and Misc have no model at all — src/audio/library.ts ships only three instruments, and selecting those types live shows '▤ Piano not found (Clav/Digital/Misc)' with RMS 0.0000 (silent). The piano spec requires 'All six piano types selectable with at least one model each' with honest synthesis explicitly acceptable for these three; the candidate chose honest silence instead of a playable model, so half the required type inventory produces no sound.

Fidelity note: the 'Upright' is a GM Honky-tonk soundfont render (tack-piano character, single velocity layer) rather than a recorded acoustic upright set — declared honestly, audibly distinct from the Grand, but a character compromise.

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
evidence: Live: enabling layer B via its panel button creates one voice per layer per key (engine.layerVoiceCount A=1 B=1), thickens output (RMS 0.0026 solo -> 0.0036 layered), and focus follows the enabled layer (hardware behavior); disabling B removes its voices.

Level fader binding verified live with layer B isolated: Home sets level 0 (state), End sets 127; audible drop from RMS 0.0042 to 0.0005. Octave shift on the focused layer doubled the sounding fundamental 258 Hz -> 527 Hz and shows 'Octave +1' feedback; octave selects different recorded zones per layers.test.ts.

Cleanup: after 40 rapid noteOn/noteOff across both layers, activeVoiceCount returns to 0; blur releases all voices (0 after window blur); layers.test.ts and graph.test.ts assert per-layer bus ownership through real node connections.

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
evidence: All six spec'd controls verified live to change canonical state and sound: KB Touch Heavy vs Light at fixed velocity 0.45 (RMS 0.0062 -> 0.0133); Dyn Comp 3 raises a soft stroke (0.0021 -> 0.0225); Timbre steps cycle state with per-family lists (acoustic 4, electric 6 incl. Dyno) and drive the bus EQ (timbreTreble.gain reads -4.5 dB at 'Soft' and dynComp.threshold -21 dB at level 1 while the graph is processing — confirmed the idle-0 readings were a Chromium AudioParam getter artifact); Unison 3 adds detuned panned copies (state + RMS up, buildSampleSources adds ±detuned sources); Soft Release doubles the release tail mean (0.00005 -> 0.00010); String Res send follows damper (resSend 0.4 with pedal down + StringRes on); Master Level knob Home mutes (RMS 0.00034 vs 0.0055).
render-piano-controls.test.ts proves each control measurably changes real offline-rendered audio; pitch stick bends live playbackRate ±2 semitones; Panic works from the panel.

GAP: SUSTPED and PSTICK are indicator LEDs only (sections.tsx:356-359) — no toggle exists anywhere in src/ (grep for sustped/pstick routing returns nothing), so the spec acceptance 'sustain ... only affects layers with SUSTPED on' cannot be exercised; sustain and pitch stick are unconditionally routed to the Piano section.

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
evidence: Live: pointer key press/release, independent multi-touch (two touch pointers hold [60,64], releasing one leaves the other), pointercancel releases without stuck notes, computer keyboard KeyA=C4 with repeat suppression (second keydown does not add a voice) and visible key depression (data-pressed=true); window blur clears all held voices.

MIDI: headless Chromium denies access and the strip truthfully reports 'MIDI permission denied — keyboard, pointer and touch input still work'; CC64 half-pedal path verified via the controller (setSustain(0.5) -> engine.sustainPedalLevel()=0.5, longer damping release); soft (Z/CC67) and sostenuto (X/CC66) verified live and labeled as approximations; midi.test.ts covers note/velocity/hot-plug/disconnect/denied/unsupported.

Asset failure: with samples/ fetches aborted on a fresh page, the engine enters a labeled 'FALLBACK voice active (synthesized, not the recorded library)' state, stays playable (RMS 0.0131), and never reports ready; rapid play (30 fast notes) settles to silence with 0 voices and no console errors.

GAP: no on-screen UI sustain control exists (DOM scan found no sustain-named button) — sustain is reachable only via Space and MIDI CC64, while the spec lists 'UI control, keyboard mapping, and MIDI CC64' as three paths.

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
evidence: Injected an AudioContext-constructor counter before page load: exactly 1 construction after full interaction across pianos, layers and all effect families. diagnostics() exposes the real masterGain, limiter (DynamicsCompressor, threshold -3 dB), single rotary and both layer channels.

graph.test.ts traverses REAL node connections (fake-context edges): voiceBus->timbre->dynComp->level->mod1->...->reverb->master, exactly one node feeds the destination (the limiter, fed by master), rotary tap hangs off the reverb output, no chain skips units; parameter changes emit only setTargetAtTime events (ramped, click-free); dispose() closes the context with zero live nodes and all LFOs stopped.

Live: master gain automation observable (gain.value 0.558 -> 0.0223 -> 0.558 through the Master Level store path); voice/timer cleanup returns activeVoiceCount to 0 after stress; engine restarts cleanly after dispose (StrictMode-safe).

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
evidence: Every unit audibly processes signal live through the panel controls: Mod 1 Tremolo modulation 2.4x dry (detrended log-diff metric); Ring Mod shifts the mid-hold spectrum (centroid 44.9 on vs 49.6 bypassed mid-note) with sidebands; all six Mod 2 types produce output when cycled (Chorus/Ensemble/Spin/Phaser/Flanger/Vibe RMS 0.0015-0.0038); Delay produces repeats after release (tail max 0.0015) and the Low Pass loop filter darkens the repeat tail (centroid 93.1 -> 89.9); Amp drive/Twin colors and raises output (0.0352 -> 0.0510), LP24 at low cutoff collapses the centroid (77.2 -> 41.2); Compressor shrinks loud/soft ratio 16.2 -> 1.8; Booth vs Cathedral reverb tails differ >10x (0.00000 vs 0.00016 mean tail RMS); Rotary routed via To Rotary shows fast 5.0x stop modulation and fast/slow 3.7x with audible spin-up inertia.

src/audio/effects.ts implements distinct DSP topologies per type (allpass banks, modulated delay lines, envelope follower, ring-mod gain multiplication, feedback loop with in-loop filter/shaper, generated-IR convolver — declared generated, dual-band rotary with independent horn/rotor LFOs); nothing is a label or disconnected node, confirmed by graph traversal tests and live processing.

render-effects.test.ts asserts measured rendered-audio changes for Tremolo, A-Pan, Phaser, Chorus, Delay repeats/feedback/loop-filter, Neutral EQ mid band, Twin drive, LP24, Compressor, Reverb wet/dry, Rotary slow/fast/stop, All-FX-Off-equals-dry, and full-polyphony clipping protection. Per-type rendered assertions are representative rather than exhaustive (e.g. JC vs Small, Vibe vs Ensemble, 5 of 6 reverb types lack individual rendered distinctness checks), backed instead by distinct DSP structure and my live audibility checks.

criteria.label: Routing and control
evidence: Live store-state verification: with layer A focused, panel effect edits changed only chains.A (A.reverb.on=true, B.reverb.on=false); fx-focus-piano cycles A -> B -> Group with LEDs; entering Group copies the focused chain to both layers (copy-on-entry per manual p.48); panel SHIFT + Delay ON sets fxGlobal.delay=true and subsequent tempo edits hit both chains (A=B=127).

Bypass/wet-dry: per-unit bypass kills the Cathedral tail (0.00016 -> 0.00000), All FX Off with every unit engaged matches dry both live and in render-effects.test.ts; delay/reverb mix knobs are equal-power crossfades (mix 0 tail = 0.00000); tap tempo: three ~500 ms taps set delay tempo to 46 (~520 ms), agreeing with the display.

Order and special paths verified structurally and audibly: delay feedback filter processes repeats only (effects-routing.test.ts asserts loop membership; live repeat tail darkens while the first tap does not), Reverb precedes Rotary (toRotary gain taps the reverb output; graph test), To Rotary reroutes the layer through the single rotary instance away from the direct master tap; rotary drive/speed/stop bound to physical controls.

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
evidence: Every exercised control produced immediate coherent feedback across display, LED and sound: type selection updates the OLED piano line and type LEDs plus the sounding sample set; 'Piano not found' with flashing LED for unpopulated types; every parameter edit writes a truthful last-edit line (e.g. 'Timbre Soft', 'Delay Tempo 521 ms', 'Rotary Fast', 'PANIC — all notes off').

Status strip truthfully tracks engine state (idle -> loading -> 'Pianos ready (recorded samples) — A: Salamander Grand · B: Tine EP'), MIDI permission, and live pedal state (sustain/sostenuto/soft down/up verified while holding Space/Z/X).
piano-info button prints truthful provenance to the display: 'Salamander Grand: 3 vel layer(s), 90 files — CC BY 3.0 — Alexander Holm'.

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
evidence: Failure paths: denied MIDI reported truthfully with inputs still working; blocked sample fetches on a fresh page enter a labeled playable synthesized fallback that never claims ready; window blur and pointercancel clear all voices (0 after each); Panic silences within ~200 ms (RMS 0.0007) with display feedback.

Stress: 40 simultaneous notes cap at the 24-voice-per-layer limit with deterministic oldest-first stealing and return to 0 voices; 12 rapid Mod 2 on/off + type cycles followed by playing caused no instability; 30-note rapid run settles to silence; master limiter present (threshold -3 dB) and a rendered test asserts full-polyphony peaks stay within full scale.
Zero console errors or page errors across every browser session (initial pass, follow-ups, input tests, fallback page), matching the canonical capture's empty console log.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
evidence: Clear boundaries: library (sample zones/provenance) / engine (voices, buses, lifecycle) / effects (self-contained EffectUnit shells with input/output/update/dispose) / InstrumentStore (canonical state) / PresentationStore (panel front door forwarding bound IDs, keeping decorative controls presentation-only) / InstrumentController (unified note lifecycle) / injectable AudioBoundary-MidiBoundary-AssetBoundary-timers (src/audio/boundaries.ts).

The engine subscribes to the store so every canonical change is applied to the live graph with ramps; the same code runs against the real browser context, a real Node OfflineAudioContext, and fake contexts — demonstrated by the passing suites. Effect chains are per-layer objects keyed A/B, extensible to the Phase 3 Synth A/B/C + shared Organ chain model; the single Rotary and global/group targeting already generalize.
Diagnostics hook exposes real graph nodes for verification only; window.__stagebench is not used by app logic.

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
evidence: Ran the candidate suite read-only on a scratch copy (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, Node 22): 23 files, 203 tests, all pass in ~35 s. Feature matrix maps every Phase 2 ID (plus retained Phase 1 IDs) to real test files.

src/test/offline.ts renders the FULL engine graph through node-web-audio-api's real OfflineAudioContext reading the actual bundled mp3 files, then measures rms/peak/Goertzel band energy/zero-crossings/cross-correlation/high-band ratio — genuine audio-boundary proof for instrument distinctness, every piano control, effect processing, bypass-equals-dry, delay-repeat filtering, rotary rates, limiter behavior, velocity direction and sustain duration.

graph.test.ts asserts one context/one destination, documented unit order, no-skip chains, reverb-before-rotary and ramped automation by traversing actual node connections; effects-routing.test.ts covers focus/group/global/bypass/wet-dry/tap through the real panel path; status/fallback/pedals/layers suites cover honesty and cleanup. Tests run without network, devices or audio output.

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
evidence: Runtime quality is excellent: zero console errors everywhere, stable rapid interaction, voices/timers return to baseline, decoded sample tails truncated to 6.5 s to bound memory, lazy engine start, clean StrictMode-safe dispose/restart. Code is well-named, documented with manual page citations, and consistently typed; oxlint on src/scripts yields 0 errors (6 benign unicorn/no-useless-spread warnings on intentional iteration-safe spreads).

Reproducibility flaw: package.json omits @types/node while test files import node:fs/node:path/node:url, so 'pnpm typecheck' (tsc --noEmit) fails in an isolated checkout (TS2591) and passes only where node_modules/@types/node is resolvable from a parent directory — verified both ways on a scratch copy; the other three gates (test/lint/build) pass standalone, and build produces dist/index.html.
Minor maintainability nits: src/components/sections.tsx is a 51 KB monolith; inherited Phase 1 tests are all retained per the feature matrix and pass.

Live inspection showed all Mod 2 types audible, Ring Mod spectral change, and Booth/Hall/Cathedral tail differences, and each type has a distinct DSP topology in effects.ts.
